purpose: Additive non-Mundarica source-discovery record for an open-access peer-reviewed Munda food-environment study. Discovery metadata and article-level reuse terms are verified; participant-level data and cultural assertions remain subject to provenance, consent and MLHKP cultural-access review.

records.title: Indigenous food environment and dietary patterns of Munda community of Jharkhand, India
records.author: Suparna Ghosh-Jerath; Ridhima Kapoor; Naina Gandhi; Swati C. Nair; Aman Rastogi; Arpita Ghosh
records.notes: PubMed verifies BMC Nutrition volume 11, article 189, published 21 October 2025, PMID 41121309 and PMCID PMC12539013. The abstract reports a cross-sectional study in 201 Munda households in Jharkhand, with household surveys and food-frequency questionnaires in monsoon and winter. It reports three study-derived dietary-pattern categories in each season. This record is a source lead only until canonical source registration and exact section-level evidence promotion are committed atomically; no result is generalized to all Munda communities.
records.rights_note: Article is openly available through BMC/PMC; article-level licence/reuse terms do not override third-party-material credits, participant consent, underlying-data governance, dignity, or MLHKP cultural-access controls. Community validation is not inferred from research participation or ethics approval.
records.scope_note: Jharkhand Munda households; food environment and dietary patterns; cross-sectional research scope. Canonicalization and exact-locator evidence ingestion are next-step release tasks rather than implied by discovery.
